idea.en: Name the liver kidney diaphragm landmarks of the right upper quadrant

note.en: What you see: With the probe on the right flank, the liver fills the screen as a smooth grey organ with the bright diaphragm curving above it and the right kidney sitting below. Between liver and kidney lies Morison pouch, the dependent recess where free fluid settles first. In health the liver edge hugs the kidney with no dark stripe between them. Blood and urine both look dark, so any anechoic stripe in the pouch in a trauma patient means fluid until proven otherwise.

label.en: Liver, right kidney, Morison pouch between them, diaphragm above the liver.

note.en: Landmarks to confirm: Liver, right kidney, Morison pouch between them, diaphragm above the liver.

steps.en: What you see: With the probe on the right flank, the liver fills the screen as a smooth grey organ with the bright diaphragm curving above it and the right kidney sitting below. Between liver and kidney lies Morison pouch, the dependent recess where free fluid settles first. In health the liver edge hugs the kidney with no dark stripe between them. Blood and urine both look dark, so any anechoic stripe in the pouch in a trauma patient means fluid until proven otherwise.
Landmarks to confirm: Liver, right kidney, Morison pouch between them, diaphragm above the liver.

Common mistakes and correction: Rib shadow hiding a small pocket of fluid: move one interspace and fan fully. Mistaking the inferior vena cava for free fluid: trace the vessel to the heart before calling fluid. Too anterior a plane that misses the recess: slide toward the back until kidney and liver meet.

Normal values with units: No numeric threshold applies. In health no anechoic stripe separates liver and kidney, and the diaphragm moves freely with breath. Any new dark stripe in Morison pouch after trauma is abnormal and needs urgent senior review.

Pitfalls: A small early bleed may hide between sweeps, so repeat the view when the patient remains unstable. Fat planes can look dark and mimic fluid, so confirm the stripe in two fan positions. In late pregnancy the uterus shifts the anatomy, so adjust the window and record what limited the view.

todo.en: How to get it step by step: Place the probe in the right midaxillary line between the eighth and eleventh ribs with the marker toward the head. Angle coronal and oblique until liver, kidney and diaphragm show together. Slide up or down one space until Morison pouch lies central. Fan slowly front to back through the whole recess and glance above the diaphragm for chest fluid. If ribs shadow the pouch, move one space down rather than pressing harder.

why.en: Morison pouch is the recess between the liver and the right kidney.

q.en: Rib shadow covers the pouch. What is correct?

o.en: Press harder on the same rib space
Move one interspace and fan fully through the recess

why.en: Moving one space and fanning fully clears the shadow without pressure artefact.

q.en: What counts as positive in this view?

o.en: A new dark stripe in the pouch after trauma is abnormal
A thin fat plane is always blood
The inferior vena cava is always blood
Fluid above the diaphragm is normal
